description: Reset bare rebuild: add aliases/ to ARCHIVED_ITEMS and, after archiving, rebuild pom/settings/scrm + the FFCMD X->EXIT seed from the Recovery_Source via the shared FEAT-001 helper (RebuildOverwrite), keeping the non-destructive archive-move. Depends on FEAT-001 (and benefits from FEAT-002's hook being present, but is independent of it).
steps: Read context.json, this file, and FEAT-001.json findings FIRST. Read crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/reset_bare.rs fully, and alias_editor.rs refresh_alias_store_in_place / active_locale / user_alias_override_base.

TDD: add a failing test asserting ARCHIVED_ITEMS contains "aliases" (mirror archived_items_includes_workspace_kinds). Validates: configuration-system Requirement 19.16, command-configurator Requirement 8.4.

In execute_reset_bare, after archive_config(udd) returns Ok for a profile, call write_builtin_defaults(menus_dir, scrm_dir, alias_base, locale, RebuildOverwrite) resolving the seams for THAT profile: for the active/running profile use self.menus_dir()/self.scrm_dir()/self.user_alias_override_base() and self active locale; for a non-active targeted profile build the menus/scrm/aliases paths under that profile's udd using the same path rules the loaders use (udd.join("menus") etc.), so a targeted non-active profile is also rebuilt on disk. Keep the best-effort, non-destructive archive-move behaviour unchanged.

For the active profile, after the rebuild call self.refresh_alias_store_in_place() so the live resolver picks up the rebuilt X->EXIT without a restart; reset_in_memory_to_baseline continues to reopen the POM, which now reads the rebuilt pom.toml.

TDD (shell suite, isolated seams): a user alias SS->SNAPSHOT present before Reset bare is archived and GONE from the live/override store afterwards, AND X->EXIT is restored in aliases/<locale>/FFCMD.toml (Validates: configuration-system Requirement 19.16/19.17, command-configurator Requirement 8.4); menus/pom.toml, settings.toml, scrm.toml exist on disk after Reset bare with Complete content (Validates: configuration-system Requirement 19.17, screen-snapshot-scrm Requirement 22.8/25.5); after reset the reopened POM + reloaded alias store read the just-written files (Validates: configuration-system Requirement 19.18).
Update the two existing reset_bare tests that enumerate ARCHIVED_ITEMS / assert the archived set, to include aliases. List each changed test and why in findings.
Run the scoped checks and cargo test -p ff-desktop reset_bare; read output; fix clippy/fmt. Keep reset_bare.rs under 400 non-test lines (split tests to a sibling if needed).
acceptance_criteria: ARCHIVED_ITEMS includes aliases and a present aliases/ dir is moved into config-archive/<timestamp>/ (non-destructive).

After a confirmed Reset bare, pom/settings/scrm and aliases/<locale>/FFCMD.toml are rebuilt on disk from the Recovery_Source via the shared helper, and a prior user alias (e.g. SS->SNAPSHOT) is gone while X->EXIT is restored.
When the reset targets the running profile, the live alias store and reopened POM read the rebuilt files.
Existing reset_bare archive tests updated for the new ARCHIVED_ITEMS; no pre-existing reset behaviour broken.
cargo clippy -p ff-desktop -- -D warnings clean; cargo fmt -p ff-desktop -- --check passes.
verification: C:\tools\powershell7\pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "cargo test -p ff-desktop reset_bare"; read output.
